name: specification
help:
usage: work specification [-h] {prepare,preview,apply,verify,recover,reconciliation-prepare,reconciliation-preview,reconciliation-apply,reconciliation-recover} ...

positional arguments:
  {prepare,preview,apply,verify,recover,reconciliation-prepare,reconciliation-preview,reconciliation-apply,reconciliation-recover}
    prepare             Prepare a semantic specification revision.
    preview             Validate and review a prepared revision.
    apply               Publish an approved revision.
    verify              Verify a published revision.
    recover             Recover an interrupted approved revision.
    reconciliation-prepare
                        Prepare execution deviation reconciliation.
    reconciliation-preview
                        Review execution deviation reconciliation.
    reconciliation-apply
                        Publish approved execution deviation reconciliation.
    reconciliation-recover
                        Recover approved execution deviation reconciliation.

options:
  -h, --help            Return command help in a JSON response.

children.name: prepare
children.help:
usage: work specification prepare [-h] --input-file INPUT_FILE
                                 --user-config-root USER_CONFIG_ROOT
                                 [--skill-root SKILL_ROOT]
                                 [--output-file OUTPUT_FILE] [--summary]
